next_step: Schedule cost-optimization workshop; finalize quantization profile for POC; provide Dedicated pricing band
blockers: lack of detailed cost model for large-scale embeddings
notes: Background: mid-market product analytics company building in-app product assistant + semantic search for customer-facing docs and onboarding flows.
Initial contact Q4 2025 via inbound CTA. AE Jordan Kim → discovery call 2025-11-12.
Early interest in Hosted API for fast integration, want to evaluate Dedicated if throughput/cost justify it.
Use-case details: hybrid workload — embeddings index for search (nightly bulk + incremental), chat assistant for in-app help (low latency), reranking for results.
Performance targets: 95th pct latency < 120ms for short chat responses, p50 < 50ms for embeddings lookup path; throughput target 150-250 req/s peak across nodes.

Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget conscious. Targeting ARR-friendly unit economics, looking for model + infra combos to hit estimated ARR range. Asked for worked example: cost per 1M tokens and cost per 100k embeddings queries.
Model preference: prefer open models. Primary candidate: meta-llama-2-13b-family (quantized variants) with fallback to 7b family during bursts to control cost.
Routing/fallback: needs automated fallback to cheaper model variant when Dedicated capacity is constrained; cross-region fallback acceptable with data residency guardrails.
Security: must pass SOC2, require SSO/SAML, audit logging, KMS integration, and ability to restrict data residency to US regions for customer PII. Procurement flagged KMS + audit questions.

POC plan: 6-week scoped POC. Week 0-1: baseline with Hosted API using existing prompts; Week 2-4: Dedicated demo + config tuning (batching + KV cache); Week 5-6: cost workshop, quantization testing and final performance report.
Demos/meetings: Hosted API quickstart demo 2026-01-22 (SE on call: Priya R.). Dedicated demo 2026-02-20 (performance bench run). Security deep-dive 2026-02-24 with infra/security team.
POC metrics to capture: latency p50/p95, tokens per second, effective cost per 1k tokens, embeddings cost per vector, memory footprint w/ 4-bit vs 8-bit quantization.

Optimization asks: recommended batching window (target <50ms added latency), KV/prefix caching to reduce repeated context tokens, recommended quantization profile (4-bit int8-like profile for 13B), suggested autoscaling thresholds and reserved burst capacity sizing.
Quote from CTO on Sec call: "We cannot expose raw customer PII outside our VPC — encryption + KMS non-negotiable."
Quote from Head of Product: "Latency is the user-facing metric; we can trade off model size vs cost but tail latency must stay low."
Procurement & legal: initial SOW requested, procurement timeline ~6-8 weeks after POC. Need Dedicated pricing band and enterprise SLA options to move forward.
Immediate blocker: need completed security questionnaire (SEC-1283) and Worked Cost Model (token-level unit economics) for their 1-year traffic forecasts.

Action items: AE to send Dedicated pricing bands and example cost model, SE to run quantization microbenchmarks for 13B->4bit, schedule 90-minute cost optimization workshop with infra and product (target week of 2026-03-07).
Internal notes: good chance to land Dedicated if cost model shows >30% savings over Hosted for projected volumes; candidate for Redwood Optimize upsell post-procurement.
